rev: Form CRA, Combined Registration Application (COM/RAD-093, Rev 11/25)
notes: One application for Maryland's sales and use tax license, employer withholding and the unemployment insurance account (Sections A to F). Answers: dates are printed as MMDDYYYY, as the form asks. Owners are one per line, 'Last, First, Title', with their addresses and telephone numbers on two more answers in the same order (up to three); 'Yes' or 'No' ticks the matching box. Left for the applicant: every Social Security Number box (1b on each page and each owner's), which Placetta never writes; the 'Maryland number if registered' column; the cannabis, tobacco wholesale and motor fuel detail boxes; the electronic filing opt-in; and the signature and date. No fee. It may be faxed (410-260-7908, Sections A and E filled, no cover sheet) or mailed to Central Registration, or the same registration made online.
